minted.name: checkout-forms-engineer
minted.rationale: AMSD-1919 pins the defect to a concrete line — CheckoutForm.tsx's confirmEmail validate rule doing `value !== email` — so this project needs an implementer who owns react-hook-form validation logic in the checkout flow to correct that specific case-sensitive comparison.

minted.name: gotransit-checkout-detective
minted.rationale: The survey flagged that the client-side fix in CheckoutForm.tsx may not be the only place this equality check lives, so gotransit needs its own investigator to confirm or rule out duplicate server-side or shared-schema validation before the implementer's fix is considered complete.
